<thought>Analyzing the spectrum, the most distinctive isotopic pattern is a peak exactly 2 Da higher than the base peak (233.96 → 235.96) with an intensity of about 24 % of the base. This matches the natural abundance ratio of ³⁷Cl to ³⁵Cl (≈24 %). No other element shows a characteristic 2 Da isotopic pair with that ratio (bromine would be ~1:1, sulfur ~4 %). Therefore, chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotopic distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
